BKN055-060 marine layer suppressing insolation with ENE flow advecting cold upstream air (KBDR 60.8F, KHPN 59.0F, advection_potential -4.1F). Curve model peaks at 71.6F but the actual tape shows temps FALLING through the morning against a rising curve expectation—curve_dev of +7.1F means current obs are already 7F BELOW the modeled curve. The B69.5 market at 27 YES / 73 NO (fair shot but not near-certain) and run_max already 69.08F offers some comfort, but the suppressed and falling morning trend with persistent marine deck argues the day struggles to decisively clear 68F. Not near-certain enough to concur at 98c ask.
